Name: NongDarn's Official Anime Bachelor Portraits
Author: DPitSimp
Description:
[b]NOTICE FOR MODERATORS: After the removal of the mod, I found the mod author, and received OFFICIAL PERMISSION to release this mod, use their assets, and make any alterations as necessary. If needed, I can provide screenshot proof that they have given me permission to do this. Thank you[/b]


This mod turns the beautiful bachelor portraits by NongDarn into an easily accessible and installable mod for Content Patcher. The original mod included XNBs for Sam, Sebastion, Elliott, Harvey, and Alex. My conversion adds Beach and Winter portraits for them, as well as the 3 ND-styled Sam portraits that were added by 1.6.

NongDarn has also graciously given me extra files such as a female Elliott portrait and an alternate version of Harvey with no beard, those will be added as optional files in the future.

Installation is simple, just extract the .zip, drag the "[CP] Bachelor Portraits by NongDarn" folder into your mod folder, and play the game!

Many thanks to NongDarn for their permission, and for their beautiful work on these portraits.


[b]TO DO:[/b]
-Elliott female portrait
-Harvey alternate beardless portrait
-If I can, I'd also like to convert Vincent's and Jasmine's portraits for CP
